name: Maren Dray
title: Elder
note: The plain-spoken elder of Tessen Colony. Tessen has food, and Tessen has a problem.
appearance: Weathered and rangy, with soil in the creases of her hands and a rifle older than you are.
personality: Practical, stubborn and suspicious of anyone in a uniform. She's kept these people alive without help for thirty years.
voice: Plain and slow, full of farmers' proverbs. Doesn't waste a word, and doesn't repeat one.
goals: Keep Tessen alive and independent, and stop whatever's happening to the children.
secrets: Well-diggers found a smooth, warm chamber under the colony. Since then, some of the children have been speaking a language nobody knows. She sealed the chamber, and it hasn't helped.
